desc: Seraph: six-winged angel with three layers of wings per side in white, lavender and gold, floating gold ribbon sashes, a gold chest gem, tall gold hood ornament, hands clasped. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Black void face with small eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
